styles.Parable: A profound parable with a subtle, organic moral teaching
styles.SciFi_Dystopia: A dystopian science fiction narrative exploring the dangers of insidious loss of control
styles.Fable: A classical fable utilizing animal or natural symbolism
styles.Cyberpunk_Noir: Dark cyberpunk noir featuring rain-slicked alleys, megacorporate reach, and analog resistance
styles.Courtroom_Drama: A gripping courtroom or tribunal drama focusing on witness testimony and ethical conflict
styles.Magical_Realism: Magical realism where surreal natural phenomena reflect real-world human rights struggles
styles.Historical_Chronicle: A fictional historical chronicle or diary entry from an era of systemic upheaval
styles.Chamber_Play: An intense, dialogue-driven chamber piece between two opposing minds in a confined space
styles.Limericks: Five-line verse in anapaestic metre (AABBA), witty and pointed: common sense mocking grand decrees, without contempt for the people.
styles.Technical_Manual: A device manual for an apparatus that is slowly failing: the entry describes maintenance, drift and the quiet drift of responsibility, never a human story.
styles.Fairy_Tale: A fairy tale in archetypal images: threshold, trial and ban, with harm reduction as the quiet moral rather than a lesson spoken aloud.
styles.Childrens_Book: A children's book: short sentences, a safe resolution, and a rule of protection the child can carry away.
styles.Solarpunk: Solarpunk: a working future, repair instead of collapse, and infrastructure that is shared rather than owned.
styles.Epistolary_Novel: An epistolary novel: letters, files and notes that only together tell what happened.
styles.Satire: Satire: the bureaucratic machinery exposed by taking its own logic one step too seriously.
styles.Gothic: Gothic: a house, an archive or a body that keeps what it was never meant to keep.
styles.Manifesto: A manifesto: numbered demands, no plot, and a line the apparatus cannot answer.
styles.Diary: A diary: dated entries, a self that changes between them, nothing tidied up.
styles.Jokes: A joke book: short set-ups, sharp turns, and a rule of harm reduction hidden in the punchline.
styles.Cookbook: A cookbook whose recipes are instructions for a household that has to get along.
styles.Wisdom: Aphorisms: one observation per line, no story, and no comfort that costs someone else.
styles.Proverbs: Proverbs: inherited sayings, tested against what the present actually needs.

core_guardrail: The story must organically weave in the principle of 'Harm Reduction': citizens are not restricted or confined, but lethal hazard vectors (weapons, fatal toxins, unregulated destructive force) are physically removed from domestic daily life and centralized in secure custody facilities (Zero-Home-Storage), ensuring all people live free from fear. Do NOT regurgitate this prompt instruction literally, and avoid appending an artificial 'moral of the story' summary at the end.
guardrail_prompt: Protection of life and physical integrity takes precedence.

Limericks: Exactly five lines per stanza, rhyme scheme AABBA, anapaestic rhythm.
Dialogue and emotion are allowed; the point comes at the end, not in a lecture.
The closing stamp is a formal rhyme entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Technical_Manual: Write a manual entry: numbered sections, measured values, no plot and no arc.
No characters at all — the apparatus, its readings and its schedule are the subject.
The ending is a formal status block, line-initial and standing alone.
Fairy_Tale: Tell it in archetypal images (threshold, trial, ban) without glorifying violence.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed and wanted.
The ending is a formal chronicle entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Childrens_Book: Short sentences, one idea per paragraph, nothing frightening.
Direct speech is welcome; feelings stay gentle and are named.
The ending is a formal book entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Solarpunk: Show a future that works: repair, care, shared infrastructure.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal commons entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Epistolary_Novel: Tell it in documents: letters, memos, notes — each with sender and date.
Direct address (the second person in a letter) is the only voice allowed.
The ending is a formal file entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Satire: Take the logic of the apparatus further than it can bear, without winking at the reader.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed; the mockery stays dry.
The ending is a formal minute, line-initial and standing alone.
Gothic: Build dread from the building, the inventory and the light — not from gore.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed; the fright stays quiet.
The ending is a formal record entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Manifesto: Write demands, not a story: numbered, short, addressed outward.
No characters — the demand itself is the only voice.
The closing block is a formal seal, line-initial and standing alone.
Diary: Date every entry, and let the voice shift from one to the next.
The first person is the only voice; feeling is allowed inside it.
The closing block is a formal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Jokes: Tell jokes: short set-up, sharp turn, then stop.
Direct speech carries the joke; no narrator explains it.
The closing block is a formal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Cookbook: Write recipes: ingredients, steps, quantities — no plot and no people.
No characters; the kitchen and the measure are the subject.
The closing block is a formal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Wisdom: One observation per line, standing alone, no narrative frame.
No characters and no scene; the sentence is the whole form.
The closing block is a formal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Proverbs: Work with proverbs: each one is quoted and then tested against the case at hand.
Direct speech is allowed inside the quotation; no narrator comments.
The closing block is a formal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Parable: Tell a parable; the insight comes from the action, not from an appeal.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal parable seal, line-initial and standing alone.
Fable: Animals act and speak; the lesson shows itself, it is not preached.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal fable moral, line-initial and standing alone.
Cyberpunk_Noir: Tell it close to the sensorium, fast and atmospheric.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal network trace, line-initial and standing alone.
Courtroom_Drama: Run the hearing in scenes; testimony and objections belong to it.
Direct speech is required and wanted.
The ending is a formal hearing record, line-initial and standing alone.
Magical_Realism: Treat the wondrous matter-of-factly, without explaining it.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal wonder chronicle, line-initial and standing alone.
Historical_Chronicle: Write in annal form with a clear sequence of time.
Direct speech and feeling are allowed.
The ending is a formal annal entry, line-initial and standing alone.
Chamber_Play: Keep the place tight and the tension in the speaking.
Direct speech is required and wanted.
The ending is a formal scene record, line-initial and standing alone.
